title: Fixture not working on advanced app template

body:
Hi, i got an error for loading and generating fixture on a fresh install of advanced app template

command:
`php tests/codeception/bin/yii fixture User`
result:
`Error: The dir argument must be a directory.`

command:
`php tests/codeception/bin/yii fixture/generate-all` and
`php tests/codeception/bin/yii fixture/generate <fixture_name>`

result:
`Error: yii\faker\FixtureController::generateFixture(): Failed opening required 'C:\xampp\htdocs\yii2\project\test\tests/codeception/common/templates/user.php' (include_path='.;C:\xampp\php\PEAR')`

I see that there is no `user.php` file in `codeception/common/templates/`, instead `codeception/common/templates/fixtures/user.php`

am i doing it wrongly? or am i missing something?
